verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a public pricing page exists (elicit.com/pricing) and reveals plan tier names (Pro, Scale, Enterprise) tied to feature gating like table exports, but no evidence pack content shows actual price points, free-tier limits, or usage caps that a researcher would need to compare plans before committing. Missing for 10: actual price figures per tier, usage/query limits, free-plan restrictions, and any independent confirmation of pricing transparency.
